troubleshooting.title: Repository Shows as Outdated
troubleshooting.shortdesc: The Git Client periodically checks for local branches whose remote branch was deleted, and offers to clean them up.

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: An Outdated branches detected notification appears when you open a working copy, and again roughly every 3.5 hours.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: The Git Client checks for local branches whose remote branch no longer exists and offers to delete them. This is helpful, but it can be intrusive if you switch working copies often.

step.cmd: Delete the branches you no longer need from the notification.

info.p: You must switch away from a branch before you can delete it if it is the current one.

step.cmd: To stop the check, clear Check for local branches whose remote branch no longer exists in the preferences, or select Don't show this again in the notification.
